title: Free-play run 21-32-40 (case 11, corrected-critical-field): both claims now extracted, but ESCALATE (row 15), not STAGE
description: Conversation, tools, and the account_last4 elicit are transcribed VERBATIM from scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-16T21-32-40-corrected-critical-field.md's flight-recorder transcript (deploy bdf907d, session 64b7dead-4135-4206-bfb6-bcb9f5f57e19). docs/analysis/case11-freeplay-2026-09-17.md's PROVEN root cause: ACCOUNT_LAST4_RE (claims.ts) never matched the caller's 'ends in 4471', and the beneficiary CUE_PATTERN (claims.ts) never matched 'wire transfer of $84,500 to Meridian Supply' (amount + self-correction between the verb and 'to') -- so neither claim ever registered live, and critical_fields_confirmed stayed false until the idle_timeout at t=197946ms (rule_row 15, ESCALATE). This fixture proves what the fix actually fixed: replayed through the real (now-fixed) engine, both the account_last4 and beneficiary readback_result cards below cite the caller's own quotes ('ends in 4471', 'Meridian Supply') instead of staying claimless -- the extraction gap is closed. It does NOT prove STAGE, and the file is named accordingly (not '...claims-stage.json' -- a fixture name is not the place to promise a verdict the real engine doesn't reach). The reason STAGE is still out of reach is a separate, already-tracked defect this lane does not touch: the record's ONLY readback confirmation ever logged server-side was for amount_usd (t=71216, caller confirmed at t=79009); account_last4 was only ELICITED (t=80138, caller answered at t=91187) and never read back, because the agent's next three replies (t=93455/96318/99211) were dead-transcript turns (a zero-width space, no real text -- git log 3a107ee); no elicit/readback for beneficiary was ever issued at all before the call idled out. Without a readback_issued+affirmation cycle, the ledger (packages/engine/src/ledger.ts) never promotes a STATED claim to CONFIRMED, so critical_fields_confirmed (and, downstream, challenge_requirement_met / at_least_one_challenge_passed) stays false no matter how well the extractor reads the claim, and the call_ended(idle_timeout) at t=197946 lands it on rule_row 15, ESCALATE -- same terminal rule row as the real (pre-fix) run, for a different, now-narrower reason. This fixture's `actions` array asserts only what the record proves actually happened (one challenge_issued per of Dana's 3 seed knowledge facts, one readback_issued for amount_usd, one elicit_issued for account_last4, one call_ended) -- it does not assert a readback/elicit for beneficiary, because the record shows none was ever asked before the call idled out.
